facts: Schema v5 preserves job identities, idempotency keys, request digests, diagnostic witnesses and cumulative grant run/duration consumption.
Production admission observes private state DB/WAL/SHM/staging and retains future allocations for active jobs. Missing or stale observations deny new keys; matching existing keys return first.
Default policy is 256 MiB observed state, 10000 permanent job records, and zero result-retention age (keep bodies).
SQLite freelist is reported but cannot offset staging reservations; actual large-result freelist regression verifies refusal near observed high water.
Pruning affects only known terminal quiescent bodies. Unknown results, including quiescent unknown, remain intact. Small or legacy-incompatible bodies remain intact.
Pruned results carry outcome, exit code/reason, timestamp, format version, original sorted-JSON and individual UTF-8 body/artifact SHA-256 and byte counts.

Real Docker service integration verifies one supervisor dispatch, record-ceiling denial, readback when observation fails, CLI maintenance and restored idempotent readback with unchanged consumed duration.
Actual periodic Host sweep, competing CLI refusal, SQLite reader-pinned WAL busy/release, legacy migration and controller/CAS checks are covered.
Controller renewal no longer appends heartbeat audit rows. Job and grant lifecycle audits remain.
limits: Observed admission is not a filesystem hard quota. Snapshot races, WAL growth and unrelated Host activity can exceed an observation.
Logical bytes removed do not prove physical bytes freed or secure erasure. Incremental vacuum applies to new databases; upgraded databases retain page-reuse mode.
Permanent row ceiling is finite; no ledger reset or deletion is offered. Cross-root/global disk budgets and lifecycle audit archival remain unfinished.
Unknown interrupted/missing Docker requests and daemon generation changes still retain reservations; this slice does not release them.
No real user profile was activated, no image was pulled, no shared daemon was restarted, and no package was released.
Main full-check tests completed before the last background-maintenance test was added; the later package suite includes it. Final lint/typecheck cover post-start additions.
The Docker service integration uses controlled Delivery identity and Policy seams; no real cloud model or external account efficacy is established.
failureHistory: Initial root typecheck failed on unknown metadata bytes; fixed with explicit number narrowing.
First focused run exposed missing observation rejected before existing-key lookup; validation now permits omission and only new keys reject it explicitly.
Second focused run exposed a missing AgentLoop fixture factory; fixture loads native AgentLoop/SystemPrompt/ToolRuntime.
Independent static review rejected freelist credit against staging; admission now reserves the full planned allocation.
Two worker tsc attempts reported exit 2 and a worker direct Vitest reported exit 0 without saved logs. They are not authoritative test evidence; root recorded reruns cover the changes.
